import json, sys, ssl, urllib.request, uuid
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
import mcp_client
name = 'voice-default-check-' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.txt'
expected = 'The default voice workspace works.'
prompt = 'Save a new file named ' + name + ' containing exactly this text with no trailing newline: ' + expected + ' Use your default workspace.'
request = urllib.request.Request('https://192.168.228.113:8094/chat/completions', data=json.dumps({'messages':[{'role':'user','content':prompt}]}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, context=ssl._create_unverified_context(), timeout=180) as response:
    result=json.load(response)
Path('run/default-workspace-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'expected_content':expected,'response':result},indent=2)+'\n')
assert result['tools'] and all(row['ok'] and row['source']=='mcp:workspace' for row in result['tools']), result
assert any(row['name']=='mcp__workspace__write_file' for row in result['tools']), result
server=mcp_client.MCPServer('workspace','ssh',['-T','codex-workspace'],timeout=10)
try:
    tools={tool.name:tool for tool in server.start()}
    raw, error=server.call(tools['read_file'], {'path':name})
    read=json.loads(raw)
    assert not error and read['text']==expected and read['path']=='/mnt/voice-workspace/'+name, read
    raw, error=server.call(tools['run_shell'], {'command':'pwd'})
    shell=json.loads(raw)
    assert not error and shell['stdout'].strip()=='/mnt/voice-workspace', shell
finally:
    server.stop()
print(json.dumps({'passed':True, 'default_workspace': '/mnt/voice-workspace','filename':name,'reply':result['text']}))
